content: ##### Featured Insights. ##### Industries. ##### Research. ##### Company. ##### References. # Franz Kaldewei GmbH & Co. KG. KALDEWEI is a German family business that has been creating bathroom solutions that combine modern luxury with sustainable thinking, management and action for over 100 years and is now in its fourth generation. The KALDEWEI portfolio includes bathtubs, shower surfaces and washbasins made of fine steel enamel.
